falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The 79% similarity to bottom_2024_aug pattern is broken; the August 2024 bottom saw a V-recovery without retesting lows, so a break below 4,800 (the August 2024 closing low was ~4,822) would invalidate the structural bottom comparison and suggest distribution rather than accumulation

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 25 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The BLOWOFF SCORE of 40 implies controlled volatility/late-cycle behavior; sustained VIX >25 indicates panic-driven regime shift, invalidating the 'hold' signal which assumes no systemic stress event disrupting the pattern

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury yield curve uninverts and steepens by >50bps (10Y yield rises >50bps above 2Y yield)
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern occurred with curve deeply inverted; rapid steepening via bear steepening signals recession realization or Fed emergency cuts, breaking the macro conditions that enabled the August 2024 bottom to hold
